definitions.explanation: Without patterns or designs; having only one color or no decorations.

examples.japanese: {無地|むじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦Tシャツ→Tシャツ：05433_tiishatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
{無地|むじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}きだ→好き：02355_suki⟧。
⟦{柄物|がらもの}→柄物：21181_garamono⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{無地|むじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わせやすい→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧。
examples.english: Solid colors are easier to coordinate than patterned ones.

notes:
USAGE: Used as a noun or の-adjective to describe fabric, clothing, or items without patterns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無地|むじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧ (plain shirt)
- {無地|むじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{壁紙|かべがみ}→壁紙：16077_kabegami⟧ (plain wallpaper)
- {無地|むじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{封筒|ふうとう}→封筒：02952_fuutou⟧ (plain envelope)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{柄|がら}→柄：02609_gara⟧ - pattern
- ⟦{柄物|がらもの}→柄物：21181_garamono⟧ - patterned item
- チェック⟦{柄|がら}→柄：02609_gara⟧ - checkered pattern
- ⟦{縞模様|しまもよう}→縞模様：26237_shimamoyou⟧ - striped pattern

NOTE: The brand ⟦{無印良品|むじるしりょうひん}→無印良品：noentry⟧ (Muji) derives its name from ⟦{無印|むじるし}→無印：noentry⟧ (no brand mark).
